title: A runner's merge call writes its log inside the working tree, so auto mode does not stop it
why: Coordinator 11:47 CST Nov 8, from lane relayed-yes-names-head (session_013NEJKzw6Mmu5eviHC3vobt, 11:43 CST): runner 8 chained its merge call with a redirect to a log in its scratchpad (`> <scratchpad>/m1421.log`). Auto mode's judge likely stopped it because the target is outside the working folders (read from the docs, unmeasured). Harm: a stopped merge call reaches the owner as a prompt. Fix idea: runners redirect into the working tree, or call the merge tool bare; measure first that the redirect target is the trigger.
